You just need a referer-hiding plugin/extension. Here is one for chrome, for example: https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/referer-control/hnkcfpcejkafcihlgbojoidoihckciin?hl=en (I didn't use this particular one, just found it with google).

And if you're using Firefox, I believe you can do that without the need for a plugin:

Type "about:config" into the address bar and press Enter. Click through the warning.

Search for "referer". You will find a setting called "network.http.sendRefererHeader"

Change its value from 2 to 0.

Test if this works using What is my Referer?.
